title: Ground-penetrating radar finds cut voids with objects beneath the Sphinx

tellings.quote: were talking extensively over dinner about how he was part in spearheading these um sonar these readings basically ground pending trading type of radar sonar under the ground looking at voids

plain: In the 1990s, scans with ground-penetrating radar and sonar under the Great Sphinx in Giza, Egypt, are said to have found hollow spaces cut into the rock with objects inside them. The researcher Matt LaCroix says he heard this over dinner from the geologist Robert Schoch, who told him he helped lead those underground readings. If true, it would mean there are hidden chambers beneath the Sphinx that have never been opened.
